result.title: Neural networks are more modular than single neurons suggest
result.summary: Neural networks routinely develop representations in which individual neurons contribute to multiple distinct functions, leading to the widespread view that such networks lack modular organization. We challenge this conclusion by introducing a formally nested hierarchy of modularity: unit-level, which requires distinct computations to occupy disjoint neurons; orthogonal, which asks whether a rotation reveals functionally independent subspaces; and linear, which asks whether a bounded linear map can separate task-relevant computations into independent subspaces. We develop a unified framework for learning decompositions at each level and evaluating them causally through selective ablation. Across vision models, language models and multi-task Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), we find that networks which lack unit-level modularity nonetheless often exhibit clear functional modularity at the subspace level. In vision and language models, content versus style and syntax versus semantics respectively dissociate under subspace ablation despite sharing overlapping populations of neurons. These learned subspaces also align differentially with brain data, with content and style subspaces predicting higher and lower visual cortex respectively, and semantic subspaces outperforming syntactic ones in predicting language cortex activity. In RNNs trained on multiple cognitive tasks and previously shown to lack modular structure, our decomposition recovers sharp double dissociations between tasks. The absence of unit-level modularity frequently coexists with clear subspace-level modularity across domains, enabling targeted intervention on specific computations even in networks where no individual neuron is specialized, with broad implications for mechanistic interpretability and for understanding functional organization in both biological and artificial neural systems.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出单元级、正交、线性三层嵌套的模块化定义，用统一框架学习各层分解并通过选择性消融做因果评估，在视觉模型、语言模型和多任务 RNN 中发现神经元层面不模块化的网络在子空间层面常呈现清晰的功能模块化（如内容与风格、语义与句法的分离）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其子空间分解与因果消融方法可供核查 LVR 的内部状态构成与使用，例如区分视觉内容与语义/风格子空间、检验答案是否真正依赖 latent 视觉信息，但该文未涉及多模态推理本身，迁移需自行设计。
